Game Overview

Orcborn: The Great Flight puts players into a two-player experience centered on take to the skies in Orcborn: The Great Flight, where you pilot a whimsical, pedal-powered aircraft to save your fellow orcs. Navigate treacherous weather and foe-infested skies, honing your landing skills and collecting gold to upgrade your machine. Team up with friends for exhilarating cooperative missions!
